name: Exception-handling bug
description: Missing key lookup throws KeyError instead of returning fallback argument.
expected_behavior: safe_lookup returns fallback value when key does not exist.
golden_patch:
--- a/service.py
+++ b/service.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def safe_lookup(mapping: dict, key: str, fallback: str = "default") -> str:
-    return mapping[key]
+    return mapping.get(key, fallback)
